teleport.description:
Move a self-hosted project to Meilisearch Cloud. Interactive command.

Moves the data of a Meilisearch project to a new Meilisearch Cloud project, by asking questions on the terminal.

It checks that the source can export, logs in to Meilisearch Cloud, creates a project in the region, team and plan chosen, adds it to the config file, exports the data to it, and waits until the new project has indexed it. It refuses to run without a terminal.

The same steps, without questions: Run `meili auth login`, then `meili project add --name <name> --team-id <id> --resource-id <id> --sync-config --wait`, then `meili export --project <source> --project-destination <name> --wait`, then `meili task list --project <name> --statuses enqueued,processing` until it lists no task.
